rules.statement: PARA_AXI_ID_W must be declared as parameter logic [31:0] with default value 4.
The comments Parameter Description, Parameter values and Parameter unit must immediately precede the PARA_AXI_ID_W declaration.

rules.condition: When PARA_AXI_ID_W is outside the legal range 1 to 16 inclusive
rules.statement: PARA_AXI_ID_W legal range is 1 to 16 inclusive; any invalid value must cause an elaboration error.
PARA_AXI_ID_W must set the width of the AXI read/write ID ports, shared between read and write.
Address, data and APB widths must be fixed at 32 bits.
CFG-BASE must elaborate with hierarchy m_axi2apb_bridge containing m_axi2apb_rd_seq, m_axi2apb_wr_seq and m_axi2apb_apb_ctrl, and ID widths 1, 4, 16 must pass elaboration, lint and synthesis checks.
